body:
## Summary

In the `documents` profile, a few ordinary operational values are redacted depending only on the field label or on how the value is framed. They hold no personal data, and redacting them makes structured logs harder to read. Nothing leaks here, so this is lower priority than a miss.

## Reproduction (0.16.0)

```js
import { sanitize } from '@link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer';

const HASH = '9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a098765432';
const text = (s) => sanitize(s, { profile: 'documents' }).text;
const json = (v) =>
  sanitize(JSON.stringify(v), { profile: 'documents', structured: 'json' }).text;
```

### The `url` label

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `json({ url: '/api/v1/items' })` | `{"url":"[REDACTED]"}` |
| `json({ path: '/api/v1/items' })` | `{"path":"/api/v1/items"}` |
| `text('url: /api/v1/items')` | `url: [REDACTED]` |

A relative path with no personal data is redacted only because of its label.

### The `time` label

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `json({ time: '2026-01-15T10:30:00.000Z' })` | `{"time":"[REDACTED]"}` |
| `json({ timestamp: '2026-01-15T10:30:00.000Z' })` | `{"timestamp":"2026-01-15T10:30:00.000Z"}` |
| `text('time: 2026-01-15T10:30:00.000Z')` | `time: [REDACTED]` |

The same ISO timestamp is kept or redacted depending on the label, and `time` is a very common log field name.

### 40-character hex values

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `json({ commit: HASH })` | `{"commit":"[REDACTED]"}` |
| `json({ note: HASH })` | `{"note":"[REDACTED]"}` |
| `json({ note: 'commit ' + HASH })` | `{"note":"commit 9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a098765432"}` |
| `text(HASH)` | `9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a098765432` |

Redacting these may be deliberate, because some tokens are 40 hex characters. The inconsistency is the problem: the same value is treated as a secret in a JSON value and kept in text mode. If it can be a secret, the kept rows are leaks. If it cannot, the redacted rows are false positives.

## Expected

- A relative path under `url`, and an ISO timestamp under `time`, are kept.
- A 40-character hex value is handled the same way in text and structured modes.

## Acceptance

- The rows above follow one documented rule.
- A `url` value holding userinfo, a token or a personal path is still redacted.
